clips.text: I do not speak English, so this narration was generated with ElevenLabs.
This reactive contract ran out of gas credit. Each transaction to it still shows success. But the network gives it no more work.
In this buildathon, more than a quarter of the submissions have a contract in debt.
My own automation holds about sixty lREACT that cannot be withdrawn. Over-funding was the only protection.

Lifeline is a gas guardian that I set once. Its airbag listens to the network's own debt event, pays the debt, and refills the contract. Its gauge refills a contract on a cron tick, before it runs out.
Enrollment is one command. The policy is plain numbers: two refill marks, a daily budget, and a limit of rescues.
Two of my automations are enrolled, each with a transaction you can check.
Now a live rescue on testnet. This command drives a test automation until its callback contract on Base Sepolia runs out.
Now watch, at real speed, with no cut.
The debt event. The hub's reaction on Lasna. The vault's payment in a callback. The debt is zero. Nobody sent a transaction after the first step.
Here is that reaction on Reactscan, with its callback to Base Sepolia.
The debt event has this timestamp. The payment came one second later.
Three identical automations got the same load. With no guardian, three callbacks arrived. With a cron poller, also three. With Lifeline, all twenty-four.
The poller left its contract dead for about two hours.
Lifeline is not a wallet refiller. A refiller sends currency to an account. Lifeline pays a contract's debt at the gas ledger, and only that restarts a stopped contract.
A target that breaks is cut off. After two rescues, the hub quarantined this looping test contract, and paid nothing more.
A flood of junk callbacks pushed one vault offline. It lost its small fee float and a little self-care. Its other funds were not touched.
Recovery needed two transactions from the owner. The hub then repeated the waiting rescue, twenty-five seconds after its debt event.
No guest is enrolled yet.
Lifeline restores future delivery. Work that arrives during a debt is lost. Testnet only. A public pool and automatic vault recovery are not built.
Check it yourself: the repository, the live board, and JUDGE.md.
